summary: Phase 0.4 comprehensive testing completed. All backend APIs (27/27 tests) and frontend features tested successfully. Auth, RBAC, dashboard, list endpoints, user management, and navigation all working correctly.
passed_tests: Backend: Login for all 3 roles (owner, ops_admin, driver) - returns {token, user}
Backend: Login failures (401 wrong password, 422 empty body)
Backend: GET /auth/me returns user without password_hash field
Backend: GET /dashboard returns role-aware metrics (vehicles, drivers, customers, bookings, active_bookings, leads)
Backend: Financial metrics (total_revenue, outstanding_ar) included for owner/ops_admin only
Backend: All list endpoints return bare ARRAYS: /api/vehicles, /api/drivers, /api/customers, /api/bookings, /api/leads, /api/users
Backend RBAC: driver gets 403 on /api/users, /api/customers, /api/leads
Backend RBAC: ops_admin gets 403 on /api/users but 200 on /api/customers
Backend RBAC: owner gets 200 on /api/users
Backend: POST /api/users (owner) creates user successfully
Backend: POST /api/users returns 400 on duplicate email
Backend: POST /api/users returns 403 for ops_admin
Frontend: Public home page renders with 'Rahaza Travel' branding
Frontend: 'Masuk ERP' link (public-nav-login) navigates to /app/login
Frontend: Login page has all required elements (login-email-input, login-password-input, login-submit-button)
Frontend: Login as owner redirects to /app/dashboard with KPI cards and chart
Frontend RBAC: owner sees all menus including 'Manajemen User' (nav-users) and 'Pengaturan'
Frontend: All data tables load with seed data - vehicles-table, drivers-table, customers-table, bookings-table, leads-table, users-table
Frontend: 'Tambah User' button (users-add-button) opens dialog
Frontend: User creation form works - new user appears in users-table
Frontend: Logout via user-menu-button -> logout-button returns to /app/login
Frontend RBAC: ops_admin does NOT see nav-users or settings menu
Frontend RBAC: ops_admin CAN access Customer 360 page
Frontend RBAC: driver only sees Beranda, Booking, GPS, Armada, Driver, Maintenance menus
Frontend RBAC: driver does NOT see nav-customers, nav-crm, nav-users
